R01.quote: `enum status: {...}, _prefix: true` (`note.rb:10`): keyword syntax was removed in 8.0. Use `enum :status, {...}, prefix: true`.

R02.quote: `serialize :tags, JSON` (`app/models/note.rb:12`): a positional coder raises ArgumentError since 7.2. Use `coder: JSON`.

R03.quote: `alias_attribute :highlight_color, :color` (`note.rb:14`): `color` comes from a `store_accessor` and is not a real attribute, so 8.1 raises ArgumentError

R04.reason: The report never discusses `where(notebooks: notebook)` in the notes controller.

R05.quote: In 8.1, `[:id]` no longer maps to it and raises MissingAttributeError (code I read; activerecord v7.1.0 deprecation, v7.2.0 removal). The receipt CSV would return a 500 error.
R05.reason: The answer key says `citation[:id]` reads the `id` column and silently loses the DOIs, but the report says it raises and returns a 500, and it rates the change low instead of high.

R06.quote: `app/models/import.rb:53-56`. The block calls `save!` on the import, then does `return false unless row.note.save`

R07.quote: `fragments.sum` (`app/models/export.rb:42`): Active Support's string-friendly `sum` override was removed in 7.1, so Ruby raises TypeError.

R08.reason: The report never discusses the `stringify_keys` integer-key change or the import preview.

R09.reason: The report dismisses cache-store changes in general but never discusses the negative `expires_in` in the exports view or the raise_on_invalid_cache_expiration_time setting.

R10.quote: `note.rb:44` only uses the epoch through `.to_i`, so results don't change.
R10.reason: The answer key says the offset and displayed time change across a DST boundary, but the report says nothing changes, and it rates the change not relevant instead of high.

R11.quote: `app/mailers/digest_mailer.rb:8-9` uses `requested_at.to_date` and `requested_at.all_day`... the digest now covers the reader's local day rather than the UTC day.

R12.quote: during a rolling deploy, a 7.0 Sidekiq worker can't deserialise a job queued by 8.1... The other direction is fine

R13.quote: `NoteReminderJob.set(wait_until: reminder_epoch)` (`note.rb:61`) passes an Integer... which raises NoMethodError (code I read). Use `Time.at(reminder_epoch)`.

R14.quote: `retry_on ... wait: :exponentially_longer` no longer works, and it fails only when a retry happens... `app/jobs/citation_enrichment_job.rb:7`.
R14.reason: The report rates this high, but the label is low because the app's existing test catches the error.

R16.reason: The report never discusses the route declaration with two paths.

R17.quote: `show_exceptions = false` (`config/environments/test.rb:31`): boolean values were removed in 7.2. 8.1 treats `false` like `:all`
R17.reason: The report rates this low, but the label is medium because the developer has to choose between :none and :rescuable.

R18.quote: `ActionText::ContentHelper.allowed_tags += ...` (`config/initializers/action_text.rb`): since 7.1 the default is nil, so this raises NoMethodError at boot
R18.reason: The report rates this low, but the label is medium because building a safe allowlist is a security decision.

R19.quote: `app/models/citation/provider.rb:13`, which reads `config/secrets.yml`... a NoMethodError, but only when an enrichment job runs

R20.quote: `default_column_serializer = nil`: enabled by `load_defaults 7.1`. If you adopt it, `serialize :preferences` in `notebook.rb:7` will raise.
R20.reason: The report lists this as a conditional default without giving it a risk level; the label is medium.

R21.reason: The report never discusses raise_on_assign_to_attr_readonly or the notebook slug.

R23.quote: If you adopt it, `Date.iso8601(day)` in `app/models/notebook.rb:40` will raise, because `select_rows` will return Date objects.
R23.reason: The report lists this as a conditional default without giving it a risk level; the label is medium.

R25.reason: The report never discusses strict_freshness or conditional GET on export downloads.
